fields.label: Highlighted (destaque)
fields.notes: Added 2026-07-28 (apollo-events 1.5.0 -> next). Admin-only curation checkbox — apollo-events/src/Admin/Metabox.php render_config(), '1'/'' string-bool same convention as _event_is_gone above. Registered via Registry.php register_meta() filter. NOT exposed on the public /novo-evento submit form or EventsController's REST write meta_map by design (editorial curation flag, not self-service). Drives the .pev-hero highlighted-events slider on the Eventos screen(s) — see 09-plugins/apollo-events.json note for the slider prep.

fields.label: Internal ranking (0-10)
fields.notes: Added 2026-08-24 (apollo-events 1.7.3 -> 1.7.5). INTERNAL USE ONLY — NEVER RENDERED ON ANY FRONTEND SURFACE. 0 (default/worst) .. 10 (outstanding). UI: apollo-events/src/Admin/RankMetabox.php, a 0-10 select physically placed right below the Publish/Update button in the wp-admin single-event editor, visible/writable only under manage_options. Registered in apollo-core/src/Core/MetaRegistry.php with show_in_rest => false (structurally unreachable via REST or the Gutenberg meta panel) and auth_callback => manage_options. Feeds apollo_event_get_top_ranked() / apollo_event_find_best_match() in apollo-events/includes/functions.php — the generic 'best event for the moment' engine any Apollo plugin (apollo-telegram first) can call. No bulk backfill: absent meta reads as 0 via apollo_event_get_int_rank().

fields.label: Vibe tag: Underground
fields.notes: Added 2026-08-24 (apollo-events 1.7.3 -> 1.7.5). INTERNAL USE ONLY — NEVER RENDERED ON ANY FRONTEND SURFACE. $data_registry_sync_log.change: Six new meta keys registered in apollo-core MetaRegistry's `classified` map and mirrored in apollo-adverts' APOLLO_ADVERTS_META_KEYS: _classified_hostel (bool, the privacy switch), _classified_hostel_url (url, replaces the chat CTA for hostels), _classified_min_nights + _classified_max_days (int, both hostel and non-hostel), _classified_avail_start + _classified_avail_end (Y-m-d, non-hostel only). $data_registry_sync_log.not_added_here: NO field-shape entries were added to cpts[] in this file. This registry's scope is explicitly the mockup single-page truth for evento/dj/local -- cpts contains exactly those three and has no `classified` section at all. Inventing one for six admin-only fields with no mockup counterpart would misrepresent what this file tracks. Full detail lives in registry/09-plugins/{apollo-core,apollo-adverts,apollo-templates}.json under the 2026-07-28 note blocks.
$data_registry_sync_log.open_divergence: Accommodation is modelled twice across the ecosystem: apollo-adverts uses `classified` posts with _classified_type=accommodation|rent_space (where this meta lives), while apollo-templates' /casa Acomoda::Rio strip uses the `local` CPT filtered by local_type. The hostel switch is registered against `classified` only; crash.php reads the same key so it will honour the flag if a `local` post ever carries it, but the default stays locked. Unifying the two -- or registering the block on `local` too -- is a product decision, left open deliberately.
